voice.caption: True, wife — yet you tell only half. Hear the horse's tale from within: I crouched in that timber belly with the best of the Argives, and Odysseus held command of us all, when you came circling in the dark.

voice.speaker: helen-at-the-horse
voice.caption: Helen circled the horse and imitated the voices of the warriors' wives.

voice.speaker: odysseus
voice.caption: Odysseus restrained them and silenced Anticlus.
Telemachus hears proof of his father's endurance and command under pressure.

keys.beat: Menelaus answers with the story of the wooden horse.
Helen circled the horse and imitated the voices of the warriors' wives.
The hidden Greeks nearly answered; Odysseus restrained them and silenced Anticlus.
Telemachus hears proof of his father's endurance and command under pressure.
